title: The Total Chromatic Quasisymmetric Functions of a Graph
summary: In this paper, we introduce and study two variants of the chromatic quasisymmetric function of a graph: the total chromatic quasisymmetric function via vertex labeling and via acyclic orientations. The original definition of the chromatic quasisymmetric function of a graph by Shareshian and Wachs depends on a labeling of the vertices of the graph, which directly affects the properties of the coefficients appearing in the decomposition of the chromatic quasisymmetric function of a graph into different bases.
